label.purpose: Eyebrows, field captions, table headers, badge text — always uppercase.

body.purpose: Paragraphs and field values, Cabin only.

caption.purpose: Small tracked meta text (dates, phone/email footers).

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transition (hover/focus/active color and border shifts).

motion.name: ease-panel
motion.purpose: Admin detail panel slide-in — the one place the system uses transform.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA — yellow fill, black uppercase bold text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #ffed00; color: #000; padding: 1.05rem 2.2rem; border-radius: 2px; border: none; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffed00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent, bordered, sentence case.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #ffed00; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffed00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip (active/inactive toggle)
components.description: Replaces native radio buttons for category/tenue/version selection.
components.css: .ds-chip-group { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.6rem; } .ds-chip { background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.92rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip--active, .ds-chip:active { background: #ffed00; color: #000; font-weight: 700; border-color: #ffed00; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffed00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card / Format Tile
components.description: Imagery-bearing tile with a numbered pastille, used on the landing format grid.
components.html:
01
Ski Erg
1000 M
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: #111; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card__number { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; background: #ffed00; color: #000; font-size: 1.05rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-card__body { padding: 1rem 1.1rem 1.2rem; } .ds-card__name { font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; } .ds-card__metric { font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffed00; margin-top: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.45rem; font-family: sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); } .ds-field__required { color: #ffed00; } .ds-field__input { background: #141414; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius: 2px; color: #fff; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem; } .ds-field__input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #ffed00; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Payment/account/category status tag — tinted background, matching border, full-strength text.
components.html: ✓ Payé ✗ Non payé
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-badge--paid { background: rgba(34,197,94,0.15); color: #4ade80; border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.3); } .ds-badge--unpaid { background: rgba(255,107,107,0.1); color: #ff6b6b; border: 1px solid rgba(255,107,107,0.25); }

components.name: Admin Header Nav
components.description: Wraps on mobile (flex-wrap: wrap) so the sign-out control never gets clipped off-screen.
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem 2rem; padding: 1.2rem 2.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); background: #000; } .ds-topbar__brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; margin-right: auto; } .ds-topbar__mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; background: #ffed00; color: #000; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-topbar__name { font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-topbar__nav { display: flex; gap: 0.3rem; } .ds-topbar__tab { background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); padding: 0.4rem 1rem; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-topbar__tab--active { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-topbar__user { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.2rem; font-size: 0.85rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }

narrative.overview:
The system reads like a mission briefing board: a void-black ground, hazard-yellow highlight ink, everything squared off and legible at a glance. Nothing floats, nothing softens the edges — surfaces are stamped, not lifted, and the yellow is rationed so that when it appears (a CTA, a key stat, an active state) it reads as a directive, not decoration.

This is a deliberate rejection of the product's previous look, which used soft ~0.5rem rounded corners throughout. The redesign squares that off to a near-universal 2px radius as a statement of precision and seriousness, fitting an event organized by and for law-enforcement personnel in support of a police-officer charity (Orphéopolis). Disciplined and angular over friendly and soft.
keyCharacteristics: Void-black ground with hazard-yellow used sparingly, never as a background fill for large areas
Near-universal 2px corner radius — angular by design, not an oversight
Flat throughout — depth comes from hairline borders and background-tier steps, never shadows
All-caps Lemon Milk display type paired with restrained, lowercase Cabin body copy
Grids separated by 1px hairlines rather than gaps (the "filet" pattern): the seam is the background showing through, not a border

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Hazard Yellow never fills a large area — no yellow section backgrounds except the two full-bleed CTA bandeaux on the landing page, which are the intentional exception that proves the rule (maximum-urgency moments only). Everywhere else it's ink on black: text, borders, small fills.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Only Rule
rules.body: Lemon Milk never appears in sentence case or lowercase — if it's Lemon Milk, it's uppercase with tracking. Cabin never appears in all-caps for running text.

rules.name: The Filet Rule
rules.body: Grids that present a set of like items (key stats, status tiles, partner logos) use gap: 1px on a hairline-colored background with opaque children — the 1px seam is the page background showing through the gap, not a drawn border.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements communicate state through color and border-color shifts — never through transform, shadow, or scale. The one scripted exception is the admin detail panel's slide-in translateX, which is navigational motion, not a hover/lift effect.

dos: Do keep the 2px radius universal; a new component that needs to feel "part of the system" gets 2px, not 4px or 8px, and not 0.
Do wrap every flex header (flex-wrap: wrap) — this system has no secondary breakpoint bailout, so an un-wrapped header is a broken header on mobile, not a rare edge case.
Do use the filet grid pattern for any new set of like items — stat rows, tile grids, comparison rows.
Do ration Hazard Yellow: one dominant yellow element per screen, not several competing for attention.
Do pair a Lemon Milk uppercase label with Cabin body text in every new component; never introduce a third typeface.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, glows, or transform-scale/lift-on-hover anywhere — depth is tonal and bordered, not physical.
Don't fill a large surface area with Hazard Yellow outside the two landing CTA bandeaux.
Don't revert to rounded corners (0.5rem or larger) anywhere — that's the explicitly rejected previous identity.
Don't style a new status/category value without the badge pattern (tinted bg + matching border + full-strength text).
Don't introduce a second breakpoint below 860px as a fallback for a layout that should have wrapped or stacked instead.
